prerequisite_zh: 事件对象、可用 AppCore 实例
prerequisite_en: Event object and usable AppCore instance
assertion_zh: 事件字段、引用计数、销毁次数
assertion_en: Event fields, reference counts, destruction counts

prerequisite_zh: 可构造 Bundle 与多值输入
prerequisite_en: Constructible Bundle and multi-value input
assertion_zh: 键、元素数量和逐字节内容；各侧销毁
assertion_en: Keys, element counts and bytes; destruction on each side

prerequisite_zh: 真实构造入口、元素生命周期
prerequisite_en: Real constructor and element lifetimes
assertion_zh: 字段与空/重复输入；构造后销毁
assertion_en: Fields, empty/duplicate inputs; destruction after construction

prerequisite_zh: 宽字符输入、真实返回类型与环境
prerequisite_en: Wide-character inputs, actual return type and environment
assertion_zh: 非 ASCII 字符及输出字节；返回对象销毁
assertion_en: Non-ASCII characters and output bytes; result destruction

prerequisite_zh: 真实 Reader/Value 构造与错误输入
prerequisite_en: Real Reader/Value construction and malformed input
assertion_zh: 解析值、错误队列、复用及销毁
assertion_en: Parsed values, error queues, reuse and destruction

prerequisite_zh: 受控转换表、线程退出/超时夹具
prerequisite_en: Controlled transitions, thread-exit/timeout fixture
assertion_zh: 状态转换值及线程结束；不以不挂起代替断言
assertion_en: Transition values and thread completion; not merely absence of a hang

prerequisite_zh: 真实可访问性对象、注册及初始化
prerequisite_en: Real accessibility object, registration and initialization
assertion_zh: 匹配集合的具体内容；聚合对象销毁
assertion_en: Exact match-set contents; aggregate destruction

prerequisite_zh: Scene、帧事件、真实 CallbackBase 生命周期
prerequisite_en: Scene, frame event and actual CallbackBase lifetime
assertion_zh: 回调值/次数；接管方销毁且仅一次
assertion_en: Callback values/counts; exactly-once destruction by new owner

prerequisite_zh: 原测试入口与真实 stringstream
prerequisite_en: Original test entry point and real stringstream
assertion_zh: 流内容、模式、结果及两侧对象销毁
assertion_en: Stream contents, mode, result and object destruction

prerequisite_zh: 可控 manifest 文件、解析初始化
prerequisite_en: Controlled manifest file and parser initialization
assertion_zh: 路径与解析字段；失败/销毁
assertion_en: Path and parsed fields; failure and destruction

prerequisite_zh: 合法/非法 URI 样本、证书服务环境
prerequisite_en: Valid/invalid URI samples and certificate-service environment
assertion_zh: 列表内容、校验结果、输出状态与销毁
assertion_en: List contents, validation results, output state and destruction

prerequisite_zh: WebView/页面加载事件及回调注销路径
prerequisite_en: WebView/page-load event and callback-unregistration path
assertion_zh: 回调字符串、次数、捕获对象销毁
assertion_en: Callback string, count and captured-object destruction

prerequisite_zh: 真实导出与稳定输入生命周期
prerequisite_en: Real export and stable input lifetime
assertion_zh: 固定输入 hash 与同侧对照；空/嵌零输入
assertion_en: Hash versus same-library control; empty/embedded-null input

prerequisite_zh: 时钟域明确的等待/唤醒夹具、锁前提
prerequisite_en: Wait/wake fixture with explicit clock domain and lock preconditions
assertion_zh: 期限/唤醒结果、锁状态；不强接不匹配符号
assertion_en: Deadline/wake result and lock state; no forced mismatched symbol call

prerequisite_zh: 服务注册、对象类型身份与同侧对照
prerequisite_en: Service registration, type identity and same-library control
assertion_zh: 返回对象身份、字段与生命周期
assertion_en: Returned object identity, fields and lifetime

prerequisite_zh: 真实后端、模型/张量配置和释放契约
prerequisite_en: Real backend, model/tensor configuration and release contract
assertion_zh: 键、buffer 维度/内容、失败状态与配对释放
assertion_en: Keys, buffer dimensions/contents, failure state and paired release

prerequisite_zh: 原单测入口、真实输出流
prerequisite_en: Original unit-test entry point and actual output stream
assertion_zh: 转义后字节、流标志；销毁
assertion_en: Escaped bytes, stream flags and destruction

prerequisite_zh: 真实 SharedFile/AbstractItem、权限与服务初始化
prerequisite_en: Real SharedFile/AbstractItem, permissions and service initialization
assertion_zh: 共享条目/字段、失败状态、对象销毁
assertion_en: Shared items/fields, failure state and object destruction

prerequisite_zh: 可控 ResPool 状态与 Locale 构造
prerequisite_en: Controlled ResPool state and Locale construction
assertion_zh: locale 集合、重复/空集合、销毁
assertion_en: Locale set, duplicate/empty sets and destruction

prerequisite_zh: 隔离配置实例/状态，不改系统配置
prerequisite_en: Isolated configuration instance/state; no system configuration change
assertion_zh: 精确规则集合、复用及销毁
assertion_en: Exact rule set, reuse and destruction

prerequisite_zh: 确定算法及输入流、真实返回状态
prerequisite_en: Specified algorithm/input stream and actual result state
assertion_zh: 校验值、流位置/错误状态、销毁
assertion_en: Checksum, stream position/error state and destruction

prerequisite_zh: 此消费方的等待/唤醒夹具；不可继承另一消费方运行结果
prerequisite_en: Wait/wake fixture for this consumer; do not inherit another consumer's run
assertion_zh: 期限/唤醒和锁状态；两架构分别匹配符号
assertion_en: Deadline/wake and lock state; match symbols separately per architecture

prerequisite_zh: 真实 InputStream/Validate、XML 输入和错误路径
prerequisite_en: Actual InputStream/Validate, XML input and failure paths
assertion_zh: XML 字段、流位置、构造失败及销毁
assertion_en: XML fields, stream position, construction failure and destruction
